description: Vanguard S&P 500 ETF tracks the S&P 500 Index, a market-capitalisation-weighted benchmark of the five hundred largest U.S.-listed companies. It is among the largest ETFs in the world by assets and carries an expense ratio of 0.03%, reflecting Vanguard's mutual-ownership structure. VOO is a foundational holding for passive investors seeking broad domestic equity exposure at minimal cost.
